settings_template_placeholder: Example: Halo {nama}, catatan belanja di {warung} sebesar {jumlah} sudah {hari} hari. Terima kasih 🙏
settings_template_reset_confirm: Remove your template and go back to the 3 built-in tones?

settings_template_active: Template active: available as the "Custom" tone.
